$comment: Structured encoding of the SAPRF PR22 v1.1 selection document dated 12 December 2025 (verbatim source: docs/selection/pr22/2027/policy.md). Read by the Pr22V11* rulesets. Rule IDs and thresholds are stable and match the audit trail written to selection_rule_evaluations. This file is the machine-consumable companion to the verbatim doc; if the two ever diverge, the .md file is authoritative and this file must be corrected.

rules.text: Be a paid-up Member of SAPRF in good standing at the start of the selection period
Reside within the province they are affiliated with OR be a member of a SAPRF recognised club
Reside within South Africa. Exception: SA citizens abroad who shot the 2026 SAPRF PR22 Season SA Championship match.
Complete the 'Eligibility to Compete' forms and such forms must have been received by ExCo

interpretation_notes: ELG-03 is intentionally an OR (residency-in-affiliated-province OR member-of-recognised-club) - this is a v1.1 relaxation vs v1.4, which required BOTH.

rules.text: Competed in the SAPRF PR22 2026 National/International PR22 series
Compete in a minimum of 3 National Provincial 1-day PR22 matches
Compete in a minimum of 2 International/National 2-day matches
At least 1 of the 2-day matches must be out of the shooter's home province
Competed in the mandatory SA championship match of the same year
Full member of SAPRF prior to the start of the selection period (needed to claim points)
Compute weighted selection % using top 3 provincial 1-day scores (10% each), top 2 national/international 2-day scores (20% each) and SA Champs (30%).
Rescale each athlete's weighted selection % against the top-scoring athlete in the same division so the division winner sits at 100%.
Athletes at 85% and above (of the division winner) are Protea-eligible; below 85% are Federation-eligible if selected.

formula.match_score_input: Score.normalized_score (already computed by StandingsCalculationService against the highest raw score of the day)

interpretation_notes: 'Highest accumulated score of the divisional winners will be used to calculate your score' - implemented as: each athlete's raw weighted % (0-100) is rescaled by the highest raw weighted % in the same division so the division winner sits at 100. The 85% Protea threshold is measured on this division-relative %.

Provincial component uses the top 3 normalized_scores from the athlete's provincial 1-day matches in the qualifying period; national component uses the top 2 from 2-day national/international matches; SA Champs component uses the single 'final' series_level match. Athletes with fewer than the required matches in a component get a partial contribution (fewer matches, less accumulated %) - the doc does not explicitly say to zero the whole component out.

squad_quotas.note: v1.1 does not specify a separate Squad size distinct from the Team quotas below. Squad membership is derived from athletes who pass ELG+PART (and, informally, score high enough); Team is chosen from Squad.

appeals.grounds: The Selection Policy process was not properly followed and/or implemented

grounds: Loss of form or fitness assessed to affect performance at the Championships
Contravention of Athlete Agreement / SAPRF Rules / Code of Conduct / Constitution / Social Media Policy
